lines: # Runs when the round of Arena ends (the timer's on_end)
execute as @a[scores={msm_starter.arena.points=5..}] run tellraw @a [{"selector":"@s"},{"text":" wins the round!","color":"gold"}]

meta.notes: Ends a round, run by the timer when the time is up: names the players with 5 or more defeats and rebuilds the arena. Run msm_starter:arena/start again for the next round.
